description: Fill the CURRENT browser page from a vault handle (see browser_vault_list): a login item fills ONLY the password field (type the identifier/username yourself first with `fill_input` inside browser_exec); a payment item fills card number/name/expiry/CVC after the user confirms in their UI; an address item fills the address fields. Values are resolved server-side and never appear in the conversation. Refused unless the page origin exactly matches the item's bound origin (re-checked atomically at fill time). If a password manager is locked the user is prompted to unlock first. Never retry a payment_declined result.
name: browser_vault_fill

handle.description: Handle from browser_vault_list (vault_… local, op:… 1Password, bw:… Bitwarden)
